First raised by the post-merge Auditor on 2026-10-06 America/Los_Angeles. Original PR [#969](https://github.com/ChengshuLi/WorldAtlas/pull/969), immutable merge `65f7eeffdcb37afed61870b46ed7257edd9b0cab`; original research #431. Exactly 254 county IDs in the contract below; one focused PR; source/comparator evidence corrections under a new owned path only.

## Independently verified findings

1. The manifest calls source `texas-constitution` retained and verified for Article V §18. The retained gzip is 28,013 bytes, SHA-256 `3b15df1c46a4f03d91fabe64aecfed674a71fc0ffe33ec2047b87de158faa0d3`; decoded HTML is 250,874 bytes, SHA-256 `dbfba8a96dc3cd584157ca66aaafdf67e0ed15dd5a0c8a58f3d4bd0f109fc646`. Its visible text is the Texas Constitution and Statutes site navigation/code selector; it contains no cited section text or commissioners-court passage. The retrieval receipt records HTTP 200 at `https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/?artSec=5&chapter=CN.5&code=CN&tab=2`, which does not prove the provision was retained. `findings.md` and `province-assessment.json` nonetheless cite the provision as retained support. The Census guide independently states the 254 functioning county governments and commissioners courts on PDF page 161; this finding does not prove the constitutional proposition or county tier false.
2. `findings.md` says Census API features and CBF rows each resolve to one polygon per county. Its own retained row evidence shows 243 single-part and 11 multipart CBF county geometries: five with 3 components, one with 4, one with 5, one with 6, two with 7, one with 26. A single county record is not a single polygon component. The independently replayed rows and component summary agree; the prose does not.
3. The CBF archive `.prj` declares `GCS_North_American_1983`, datum `D_North_American_1983`, GRS1980. `reproduce.py` reads shapes without this CRS and passes them through the same EPSG:4326→6933 transformer as the GeoJSON sources. The report describes all source coordinates as WGS84 and omits the CBF datum assumption. This establishes an undocumented CRS assumption; no numerical displacement, legal boundary error or changed triage classification has been demonstrated. The local CRS name for EPSG:6933 is `WGS 84 / NSIDC EASE-Grid 2.0 Global`; use the actual projection/operation name when documenting it.

## Reproduction and inspected evidence

At the exact merge, inspect the pinned inputs below. Decode the constitution gzip within the 32 MiB limit; parse HTML without executing scripts, exclude script/style text, and inspect the complete remaining body. Compare it with the exact section claimed in the manifest and factual prose. An HTTP-success receipt and a matching hash prove retained bytes, not their suitability.

Read all 254 `runs/twelve/county-assessments.jsonl` rows; tally `multipart_components.census2018_cbf_500k`, and compare to `comparison-summary.json` and the quoted prose. Inspect the ZIP central directory first, read its 165-byte `.prj`, and inspect the shape-loading and common transformer code. Do not extract oversized members or overwrite the retained packet.

Auditor checks: all 75 changed files were byte-verified against head and merge; all 83 declared descriptors and declared decompressions were verified. Two bounded executions reproduced all 254 rows and 470-member area partition, with exact row/control equality to retained final runs. Independently checked all 254 Markdown identity/GEOID/classification rows, seven numerical aggregates, all five per-row validity flags, and identical/disjoint/one-third partial-overlap and axis-order controls. Worldwide scan of 33 unrelated Atlas parts and live Census/Texas HTTP ancestry were not verified. These limitations do not erase the directly visible documentation defects.

## Success criteria

Create a new dated, independently reviewed erratum/evidence packet under the owned path. Preserve all original bytes, claims, dates, IDs, parentage, metrics and historical findings as originals.

- Restore lawful actual Article V §18 section bytes with exact immutable/source URL, whole-file hash, retrieval/vintage, section citation and reuse basis; or explicitly mark the original HTML as a navigation shell/unverified provision and retain precise restoration instructions. Separate the Census guide's actual support from the unverified constitutional citation.
- Reconcile county records versus Polygon/MultiPolygon components for all 254 CBF rows and correct the source interpretation. Do not infer island completeness from record count.
- Declare each source's actual CRS and the CBF datum operation, approximation, accuracy and limits. If adopting an approximation, document and justify it rather than relabeling NAD83 as WGS84. If measuring new numerical effects, use applicable shared geometry methods/positive and negative controls, two reproducible new output vintages, truthful input/metric bindings and independent exact-head review; preserve the original numbers. Do not claim this Auditor proved a numerical error.
- Bind the erratum to the exact subjects and inputs below; show which interpretation changes and which uncertainty remains. No shared geography, hierarchy, source-catalog, release, production import, region certification or geography approval.

## Dependencies, overlap and readiness

#431 is closed and its worker reservation was released. #966 separately owns 24 unresolved boundary comparisons plus the Texas outline; #967 owns 254 GeoBoundaries source-hash lineage and depends on #954. This child addresses the retained authority/comparator interpretation only, with disjoint owned paths; coordinate factual evidence without taking their boundary or hash-lineage work. Missing external authority text is a bounded research objective, not authorization to fabricate or import it.

Complete open/closed issue pagination found no existing child covering these defects; the current open-PR inventory is empty. No active claim exists on this new owned path. It is ready for bounded source research with the exact input pins and source-review contract below, subject to the normal worker gates.
